title: Keynote: The Last Hope for Scala's Infinity War - John A. De Goes
summary: John A. De Goes's Scalapeno keynote argues that Scala's popularity is declining because of compile times, complexity and compatibility problems. He proposes a path for Scala to survive, including a simplified functional subset.
why: Cited in Scala and language-marketing discussions for its accurate account of Scala's pain points and its argument that a language's pitch must address a real developer pain.

quote.text: John De Goes describes pain points quite accurately in Scalapeno keynote
